title: Android
scope: Android packaging, permissions, hardware/runtime adapters, UI integration and releases using shared orchestration/contracts with target-optimized inference.

active_claim.scope: S24 FE build3069 critical-memory failure: bounded dismissible chat notices and recovery; investigate resource telemetry without weakening critical guard or changing shared inference semantics.

next_action: Validate UI regression tests, publish focused PR, preserve critical guard and collect further evidence before GPU policy changes.
historical_backlog: Galaxy S24 FE is the current physical inference/thermal benchmark target.
Heavy 6.7B/7B models must remain safely skipped when RAM headroom is insufficient.
Repeat Vulkan 0/10/99 only with the thermal-gate fix present and capture end receipt/Diagnostics.

checkpoints.summary: Confirmed S24 FE build3069 critical-memory cancellation at 2026-10-09 23:36:58: 33 GPU layers,1536/64/16,trim15 despite 1.17GB available. UI repeats runtime snackbar on every state and lacks close control; implementing bounded deduplicated notices. Memory safety remains open.
decisions: Do not suppress Android trim15 or infer GPU memory use from host RSS. No memory-stability claim.
